rulesStrings.li: opening->A [tract_synonym] for [IDEO_name], set down by [ANYPAWN_nameIndef] and printed on [worldname]
opening->[ANYPAWN_nameIndef] wrote this [tract_synonym] to be pressed into the hands of strangers
opening->A [tract_synonym] arguing the case for [IDEO_name], dated [date_season]
opening->This [tract_synonym] addresses itself to anyone who is not yet one of the [IDEO_memberNamePlural]
opening->The [tract_synonym] opens by conceding, at length, that the reader has every reason to be sceptical
argument->It takes the reader through what the [IDEO_memberNamePlural] believe and, more insistently, why everyone else is mistaken
argument->Whole chapters are given over to answering objections the reader has not yet raised
argument->It is written as a conversation between a [IDEO_memberName] and a doubter, and the doubter loses
argument->The middle section is a list of the things [ANYPAWN_label] gave up, and what came of it
argument->It reads less like an argument than like a letter from someone who is certain and would like company
argument(quality[greater_than]3)->The reasoning is patient and hard to interrupt, and it does not raise its voice
argument(quality[less_than]3)->The reasoning is loud, repetitive, and easier to resist the further one reads
closing->It ends by naming the [IDEO_memberNamePlural] the reader already knows
closing->It ends without a conclusion, as though expecting to be argued with
closing->The last page is blank, left for the reader to write their own answer
closing(quality[greater_than]4)->By the last page it has stopped arguing and simply describes a life, which is worse for the doubter
closing(quality[less_than]2)->It ends mid-thought, and the binding suggests nobody checked
